sourceUpdateText: Model run Nov. 2, 4:40 PM ET; polls through Nov. 2
admissionNote: The source edition advanced from 1:41 PM to 4:40 PM ET while the dedicated House and Senate control probabilities, medians, intervals and cutoffs remained unchanged. The overview joint outcomes are preserved as displayed and sum to 101% because of rounding. A separate rewind widget displays 76% Democratic Senate control, but the dedicated current Senate page and overview top line both display 75%; the dedicated current field remains the admitted statistic. Midterm Forecast is not an input to scripts/refresh-election-projections.py, so this source-edition change does not create a new KAHRELUM probability edition.
